name: HTS_WORK_PATTERNS_B
description: Table to store the work pattern information. Work patterns will be used to assign to workers.

columns.name: WORK_PATTERN_ID
columns.description: Unique system generated identifier for a work pattern.

columns.name: WORK_PATTERN_ALTCD
columns.description: Work pattern alternate code. Unique and non-translatable.

columns.name: WORK_PATTERN_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the work pattern type associated to this work pattern.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies whether work pattern is considered as a template.

columns.name: REPEAT_NUM
columns.description: Length of work pattern in repeating period unit.

columns.name: START_DAY_OF_PATTERN
columns.description: Identifies the day on which work pattern starts.

columns.name: NON_WORKING_CYCLES
columns.description: Identifies the non-working cycles in the work pattern stored as a single value with comma as a separator.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
